title: The Zombies: Different Game Tour 23 — Ticket Confirmation
description: This digital Ticketmaster purchase confirmation documents admission to a performance by The Zombies during their Different Game Tour 23 at the Brown County Music Center in Nashville, Indiana. The confirmation was issued on June 21, 2023, for the October 19, 2023, concert. The performance illustrates the continuing live musical activity of The Zombies, a British rock group that first achieved international recognition during the 1960s.
